Never poached an egg before today. Vaguely knew what was required and never bothered, because getting out a pot and boiling water takes way more time than preparing most of the things I would want to put one on. Today I made two, had them on wheat toast and they were amazing. Here's how:

Take a coffee mug, put in about half a cup of cool water. crack the egg straight into it. Prick the yolk with a knife, toothpick etc(it can explode if you don't do this, do not skip.) Put it in for a minute on high.

Use a fork or slotted spoon to lift it out, put directly onto toast, rice, pasta, salad, etc, then break it open... really good stuff.

Based on info from some other sites, for better results you can add a tiny bit of vinegar(1/8th tsp) which keeps the whites together and turn the egg over halfway through.
